description: Finds and shrinks what makes a Unity 6.3 LTS build too big: Build Report reading, uncompressed textures, glTFast models, PCM audio and per-platform levers. Use when an APK, AAB, WebGL build or Steam depot is over a size limit or the download is too big. Not for frame rate (`performance-optimization`), build scripts or stripping (`unity-build-pipeline`) or store uploads (`steam-publish`).
